newsitem.title: USA: Texas/w Oklahoma feedlot cattle roundup - USDA.
newsitem.headline: Texas/w Oklahoma feedlot cattle roundup - USDA.

text.p: Trade was slow in the Panhandle area Friday, USDA said in its roundup report.

On Friday, slaughter steers and heifers traded steady in a limited test. Feedlots reported moderate inquiry from buyers. Sales reported on 2,800 slaughter steers and 1,000 heifers; 5,400 head confirmed for week to date included 1,500 head or 41 loads of CME cattle delivered to area packing plants.
Slaughter Steers: Select and Choice 2-3 1150-1250 lbs 71.00. Slaughter Heifers: Select and Choice 2-3 1050-1150 lbs 71.00. Select, few Choice 2-3 1050-1100 lbs 70.00.
